items.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' >= date_trunc('month', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND paid_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunds FROM refunds WHERE refunded_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND refunded_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount_cents) * 100 AS percentage FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' >= date_trunc('month', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND paid_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND paid_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT method, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS failed_percentage FROM payments GROUP BY method
SELECT reason, SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS cost_dollars FROM refunds GROUP BY reason

SELECT p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'refunded', 'canceled') GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS active_users FROM users WHERE role = 'member'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN stage = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS win_percentage FROM opportunities WHERE closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(months => 12) AND closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT SUM(headcount_capacity) AS total_headcount_capacity FROM office_locations
SELECT COUNT(*) AS waiting_expense_claims FROM expense_reports WHERE status = 'submitted' AND paid_at IS NULL AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90)
SELECT c.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT l.converted_org_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS percentage FROM campaigns c JOIN leads l ON c.id = l.campaign_id GROUP BY c.channel

SELECT sales_reps.region, SUM(opportunities.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS total_value FROM opportunities JOIN sales_reps ON opportunities.rep_id = sales_reps.id WHERE opportunities.stage = 'won' AND opportunities.closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 180) AND opportunities.closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY sales_reps.region
SELECT T1.name AS campaign_name, SUM(T2.open_count) AS total_opens FROM campaigns AS T1 JOIN email_events AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.campaign_id GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY total_opens DESC LIMIT 2;

SELECT departments.name, COUNT(DISTINCT employees.id) AS current_employees FROM departments JOIN employees ON departments.id = employees.department_id WHERE employees.terminated_at IS NULL GROUP BY departments.name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS active_users FROM employees WHERE terminated_at IS NULL

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN stage = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS win_percentage FROM opportunities WHERE closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(months => 12) AND closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active', 'past_due')
SELECT p.tier, SUM(s.mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON s.plan_tier = p.tier GROUP BY p.tier

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS churned_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'canceled' AND canceled_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND canceled_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS upgrade_downgrade_events, event_type FROM subscription_events WHERE event_type IN ('upgraded', 'downgraded') AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY event_type
SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS redemption_count FROM coupon_redemptions GROUP BY code ORDER BY redemption_count DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN plan_tier = 'enterprise' THEN mrr_cents ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(mrr_cents) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount_cents) FROM invoices WHERE issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' >= date_trunc('month', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - make_interval(days => 90) AND issued_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active', 'past_due')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NULL GROUP BY priority
SELECT t2.team, AVG(t1.score) AS avg_score FROM support_tickets AS t1 INNER JOIN support_agents AS t2 ON t1.assigned_agent_id = t2.id GROUP BY t2.team

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY category

SELECT AVG(T2.resolved_at - T2.created_at) AS avg_hours, T2.priority FROM support_tickets AS T1 INNER JOIN ticket_comments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ticket_id WHERE T1.status IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY T2.priority
SELECT o.name, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets st JOIN organizations o ON st.org_id = o.id WHERE st.status IN ('open', 'pending') GROUP BY o.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT T2.team, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.score = 4 OR T1.score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage FROM support_tickets AS T1 INNER JOIN support_agents AS T2 ON T1.assigned_agent_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.team
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS customer_companies FROM organizations WHERE country = 'USA'
SELECT role, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY role
SELECT COUNT(*) AS revoked_api_keys FROM api_keys WHERE revoked_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users, country FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY country
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS sent, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications) AS read_percentage FROM notifications GROUP BY kind

SELECT org_id, SUM(error_count) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS failed_percentage FROM api_requests_daily WHERE request_date <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY org_id ORDER BY failed_percentage DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT f.key, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.usage_date >= NOW() - make_interval(days => 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS usage_percentage FROM features f JOIN feature_usage_daily fu ON f.id = fu.feature_id JOIN organizations o ON fu.org_id = o.id GROUP BY f.key ORDER BY usage_percentage DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM organizations WHERE country = 'US'
